chunks: And We said, 'O Adam, live, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat freely from it wherever you wish, but do not approach this tree, lest you become among the wrongdoers.'
ai.seo_question: What was the specific prohibition given to Adam and Eve in Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the primordial covenant where Adam and Eve were granted absolute freedom of choice within Paradise, with the prohibition serving as a test of obedience rather than a restriction of sustenance. The phrase 'from where you will' highlights the concept of *Ikhtiyar* (free will), while the consequence of becoming *Zalimin* (wrongdoers) signifies the loss of their elevated spiritual station due to the interplay of divine command and human choice.
